text:
sam: perf-bot alerted a sharp tail latency spike for /chat on us-west-2 at 14:08 UTC, digging in
perf-bot: ALERT cpu/gpu/p95_token_latency > 1200ms on route=/chat (sustained 3m) :rotating_light:
linh: grabbing GPU telemetry and token-level breakdowns now, looks noisy on SM occupancy and VRAM pressure
oliver: linking traces — I see repeated kernel-selector fallbacks to the compatibility path around the same period
sam: is that the fallback that switches to the older matmul kernel? that could increase warp divergence
linh: yes, exact pattern: primary kernel fails heuristic -> fallback -> >2x SM stall cycles. also KV prefetch eviction rate spikes
jk: can you paste the query you used for per-MIG occupancy + kv evictions? want to add to a dashboard panel
linh: here's the quick PromQL I ran:
```
avg_over_time(gpu_sm_occupancy{region="us-west-2"}[5m]) by (gpu,mig_slice)
and
increase(kv_cache_evictions_total{route="/chat"}[5m])
```
oliver: added a combined heatmap: SM occupancy x token-latency p95 per-route. shows hotspots on MIG slice 2 and 3 for node gpunode-7
sam: VRAM usage also shows a sawtooth pattern, probably because the prefetch window is too aggressive for long chat sessions
jk: hypothesis: aggressive KV prefetch + kernel fallback -> more memory copies + less concurrent warps -> higher tail latency
linh: confirmed in profiler: timeline shows repeated memcpy D2H/D2D around kernel fallback points; PCIe bandwidth saturates briefly
oliver: attaching a short flame snippet I captured (abbreviated)
```
# timeline excerpt
[0ms] kernel_A launch
[12ms] kernel_A fallback -> kernel_B
[14ms] memcpy D2D 64MB
[20ms] kernel_B launch (reduced SM occupancy)
```
sam: ok, what dashboard panels and alerts should we add to catch this earlier?
linh: propose panels: per-route token-p95, per-MIG SM occupancy heatmap, KV cache evictions by route, VRAM headroom gauge, PCIe bandwidth spike rate, kernel-fallback count
jk: alert rules: if kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5/min AND route_token_p95 > 800ms -> page oncall, also create softer paging for kv_eviction_rate
oliver: also add a derived KPI: tokens_per_active_warp = tokens_emitted / avg_active_warps (helps normalize across slice sizes)
sam: can we compute tokens_per_active_warp in Clickhouse quickly? I sketched this:
```
SELECT
  route,
  quantileExact(0.95)(tokens / NULLIF(avg_active_warps,0)) AS tokens_per_warp_p95
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
GROUP BY route
```
linh: looks good. I'll add panels to the per-route dashboard and create a new top-level 'gpu-utilization -> sm/mig/token-latency' folder
oliver: we should also add a playbook note: on kernel-fallback spike, rollback last kernel selector config and increase batching time window by 5ms as a short-term mitigation
jk: assigning action items:
- linh -> add panels + alerts (PR today)
- oliver -> update eval run to include workload that repros fallback (test infra) (EOD)
- sam -> write playbook snippet and incident checklist (tomorrow)
perf-bot: created incident INC-20260318-42 for the spike, linked to thread
sam: thanks — prioritize alerting so customers see fewer drops. we'll follow up once dashboards + playbook are live :thumbsup:
